storyTitle: Add Change Password form UI with client-side validations on Settings page
storyDescription:
As an authenticated user,
I want to change my password from the Settings page,
So that I can manage my account security from the profile settings area.

Description

Add a Change Password section to the existing Settings / Profile Settings page.

This story is limited to frontend UI and client-side validation only. No backend API integration is required.

The Settings page currently shows profile fields such as:

Name
Email
Address
Update Profile button

Below the existing profile form, add a separate Change Password form card.

Scope
In Scope

Create a Change Password form with the following fields:

Current Password
New Password
Confirm New Password

Add client-side validation and state management.

Show success toast after successful validation.

Out of Scope
Backend API integration
Actual password update
Authentication token handling
Password encryption
Server-side validation
Forgot password flow
UI Requirements

Add a new card below the existing profile settings card.

Section Heading
Change Password
Section Subtitle
Update your account password securely
Fields
Current Password
Type: password
Placeholder: Enter current password
Required
New Password
Type: password
Placeholder: Enter new password
Required
Confirm New Password
Type: password
Placeholder: Confirm new password
Required
Button
Change Password

The button should remain disabled until all fields are filled.

Validation Rules
Current Password
Required
Show error message if empty:
Current password is required
New Password
Required
Minimum 8 characters
Must contain at least one uppercase letter
Must contain at least one lowercase letter
Must contain at least one number
Must contain at least one special character

Error messages:

New password is required
Password must be at least 8 characters long
Password must contain uppercase, lowercase, number and special character
Confirm New Password
Required
Must match New Password

Error messages:

Confirm password is required
New password and confirm password do not match
Same Password Validation

New password should not be same as current password.

Error message:

New password must be different from current password
Functional Requirements
Initial State

Given the user opens the Settings page
Then the Change Password form should be visible below the Profile Settings form
And all password fields should be empty
And the Change Password button should be disabled

Enable Button

Given the user enters values in all password fields
When all fields are non-empty
Then the Change Password button should become enabled

Validate Empty Fields

Given the user focuses and leaves any password field empty
Then the relevant validation message should be shown

Validate Password Strength

Given the user enters a weak password in New Password
When the password does not satisfy the password rules
Then the appropriate validation error should be shown

Validate Confirm Password

Given the user enters a Confirm New Password value
When it does not match New Password
Then show:

New password and confirm password do not match
Submit Valid Form

Given the user enters:

Current Password: Admin@123
New Password: NewAdmin@123
Confirm New Password: NewAdmin@123

When the user clicks Change Password
Then show a success toast:

Password changed successfully

And clear all password fields after successful submission.

State Management Requirements

Maintain local state for:

currentPassword
newPassword
confirmPassword
errors
isFormValid
isSubmitting

No global state or backend storage is required.

Acceptance Criteria
Given I am on the Settings page
When I scroll below the Profile Settings form
Then I should see a Change Password section
Given the Change Password form is visible
Then it should contain Current Password, New Password and Confirm New Password fields
Given all password fields are empty
Then the Change Password button should be disabled
Given I fill all required fields
Then the Change Password button should become enabled
Given I enter a new password with less than 8 characters
When I submit the form
Then I should see a password length validation error
Given I enter a new password without uppercase, lowercase, number or special character
When I submit the form
Then I should see a password strength validation error
Given Confirm New Password does not match New Password
When I submit the form
Then I should see password mismatch validation error
Given New Password is same as Current Password
When I submit the form
Then I should see an error saying new password must be different from current password
Given all password fields are valid
When I click Change Password
Then I should see a success toast saying "Password changed successfully"
And all password fields should be cleared
Suggested UI Placement

Place the Change Password card below the existing Profile Settings card.

Suggested layout:

Profile Settings
[Existing profile form card]

Change Password
[Current Password]
[New Password]
[Confirm New Password]
[Change Password Button]
Technical Notes
Use local React state.
Use controlled input fields.
Use password input type for all password fields.
Display inline validation errors below respective fields.
Use the existing toast notification pattern already available in the project.
Follow the same dark theme, card style, spacing, border, input styling, and button styling as the existing Settings page.
No API service file is required for this story.
No backend dependency is required.
